subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw expose blocked Telegram/WhatsApp DM content to trusted pre-auth hooks and make grouped DM allowlist config part of the channel/plugin contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but choosing this pre-admission content boundary and public config/API shape is a maintainer security and compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve bounded pre-auth contract
options.body: Accept the hook, grouped allowlist entries, and trusted auto-load behavior after owner review confirms the exposure and upgrade behavior are intentional.

options.title: Narrow to private access requests
options.body: Keep the workflow but remove or privatize plugin-facing hook/config surfaces until the permanent API is designed.

options.title: Defer to shared denied-inbound audit
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of a broader channel-agnostic audit/event design for unauthorized inbound visibility.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded pre-auth contract
recommendation.body: Accept the hook, grouped allowlist entries, and trusted auto-load behavior after owner review confirms the exposure and upgrade behavior are intentional.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history across allowlist command/config-write policy and plugin/channel seam surfaces that determine this decision.
